# PeerDH

> > Programming tutorials and insights covering Python, JavaScript, Django REST APIs, quantum computing with Qiskit, data structures, IoT, and web development.

PeerDH is a technical education platform offering hands-on tutorials and guides for developers. The site features practical projects ranging from data visualization with Pandas and Matplotlib to quantum computing simulations, hash table implementations, and smart home automation systems.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- Django REST Framework
- Node.js
- Qiskit
- Data Structures (Hash Tables)
- API Development
- Data Visualization (Pandas, Matplotlib)
- Quantum Computing
- IoT and Home Automation
- Web Development (HTML, CSS, React)
- Collision Resolution
- Encryption and Security
- Game Development (Unity, Unreal Engine)
- Network Troubleshooting

## API Development & Backend

- [Develop A Rest Api For A Task Management Application Using Django Rest](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/develop-a-rest-api-for-a-task-management-application-using-django-rest-framework-2): Django REST Framework tutorial with authentication and CRUD operations
- [Developing A Rest Api For A Social Media Application](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/developing-a-rest-api-for-a-social-media-application-2): Node.js/Express REST API for social media with rate limiting
- [Create A Simple Password Manager That Securely Stores And Retrieves Pa](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/create-a-simple-password-manager-that-securely-stores-and-retrieves-passwords-emphasizing-encryption-techniques): Python password manager tutorial using Fernet encryption

## Data Structures & Algorithms

- [Developing A Simple Hash Table With Collision Resolution Techniques](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/developing-a-simple-hash-table-with-collision-resolution-techniques): Hash table implementation in Python with collision resolution methods
- [Develop A Simple Hash Table With Collision Resolution Techniques](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/develop-a-simple-hash-table-with-collision-resolution-techniques-1): Python hash table implementation with collision handling strategies

## Web Development & Design

- [Responsive Web Design: Best Practices For Modern Websites](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/responsive-web-design-best-practices-for-modern-websites): Best practices for responsive design with CSS and WCAG guidelines
- [The Evolution Of Web Development: From Static Pages To Dynamic Applica](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/the-evolution-of-web-development-from-static-pages-to-dynamic-applications): Web development history from HTML to React and modern frameworks
- [Network Troubleshooting Guide: Common Issues And Command-line Solution](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/network-troubleshooting-guide-common-issues-and-command-line-solutions-2): Network diagnostics guide using ping and traceroute commands

## Data Visualization & Analysis

- [Create A Project That Visualizes Survey Results Using Bar Charts And P](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/create-a-project-that-visualizes-survey-results-using-bar-charts-and-pie-charts-2): Python data visualization tutorial using Matplotlib and Pandas
- [Build An Interactive Map Using Folium To Visualize Geographical Data](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/build-an-interactive-map-using-folium-to-visualize-geographical-data-1): Folium/Leaflet.js tutorial for interactive geographical data maps

## Quantum Computing & Advanced Topics

- [Develop A Project That Simulates A Quantum Random Number Generator Usi](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/develop-a-project-that-simulates-a-quantum-random-number-generator-using-quantum-principles-to-generate-random-bits-1): Quantum RNG tutorial using Qiskit and Python with Hadamard gates

## IoT & Hardware Projects

- [Build A Basic Motion Detection System Using A Pir Sensor](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/build-a-basic-motion-detection-system-using-a-pir-sensor): Arduino tutorial for PIR sensor motion detection system
- [Create A Smart Home Lighting System That Allows Users To Control Light](https://peerdh.com/blogs/programming-insights/create-a-smart-home-lighting-system-that-allows-users-to-control-lights-remotely-using-a-mobile-app-or-web-interface-1): Smart home IoT tutorial for remote lighting control with Philips Hue
